title: Blind Pass Boat and Jet Ski Rental
specs: Access to hidden local spots like Shell Key, Egmont Key, John’s Pass Sandbars
U.S.C.G. licensed captains for all charters except Tiki Boat
Jet ski tours offer dolphin watching and exploration of local wildlife
Must be at least 18 years old with valid ID to rent jet ski or power boat
Jet ski operators must be at least 16 years old with parental consent and valid driver’s license, boating education card, and $500 deposit
Drivers must be 25 or older with valid ID to rent deck boats
Operators born after Jan 1, 1988 must have boating safety certificate
Major credit card required for $500 refundable deposit per vessel
Deck boats accommodate up to 6 people; Bulldog Tritoon up to 8 people
Private charters accommodate 1-25 people depending on vessel

blurb: Guests can rent deck boats and jet skis or book private charters including tiki boat, sandbar parties, watersports excursions, snorkeling, dolphin watching, sunset cruises, and custom speed boat charters. All charters include a U.S.C.G. licensed captain. Rentals allow exploration of local coastal and near-coastal waters with access to various local points of interest.
extraNote: 24 hour cancellation notice required to avoid $100 fee · No-call/no-show charged full rate · No cancellation fee for bad weather with option to reschedule · Must return to dock at least 1 hour before sunset · Jet ski rentals have no reservations; tours require minimum 2 skis · All vessels must board, depart, return and disembark from dock at 9555 Blind Pass Rd, St Pete Beach, FL 33706.
